name: retro-film-arcade-ice-cream-girl
image_vibe: Harsh direct flash, Japanese urban arcade, high-grain 35mm retro color film
image_purpose: Create a candid arcade snapshot with playful ice-cream action and authentic film texture.

prompt.project_info: A candid 35mm film photograph in a cluttered urban arcade corner at night.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark hair and bangs holds a melting vanilla soft-serve cone near her mouth while casually touching her hair and looking naturally at the camera. She wears an oversized blue-and-white striped short-sleeve shirt with a beige canvas tote strap visible.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject beside a brightly lit vintage Japanese pachislot machine with butterfly motifs, cluttered dim arcade corner, direct gaze, and candid 3:2 street-photography framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct on-camera flash creating hard shadows, bright machine glow, dim urban surroundings, high grain, and realistic retro color-film atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:2 35mm street snapshot, authentic retro color film, high grain, realistic textures, natural hair and fabric detail, raw candid rendering.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid 3:2 35mm film photograph of an original adult woman with dark hair and bangs, holding a melting vanilla soft-serve ice-cream cone near her mouth while casually touching her hair and looking directly at camera. She wears an oversized blue-and-white striped short-sleeve shirt with a beige canvas tote strap visible. Place her beside a brightly lit vintage Japanese pachislot machine with butterfly motifs in a cluttered dim urban arcade corner at night. Use harsh direct on-camera flash, hard shadows, high film grain, authentic retro color-film aesthetics, and realistic textures.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, distorted ice cream, plastic skin, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source arcade snapshot reference
assets.usage: Use only for arcade layout, ice-cream action, wardrobe palette, flash, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the arcade, pachislot butterfly motifs, vanilla ice cream, striped shirt, tote strap, direct gaze, and 35mm flash aesthetic. Keep the subject original adult; arcade props may vary.
